  PROBLEM: `build_autofix_failure_payload` joins the last eight comments chronologically and applies whole-text prefix truncation instead of using `_build_recent_comments_excerpt`.

  WHY: Workflow-dispatch run titles generally use the workflow name and branch rather than the issue title, so the fallback rejects candidates and can leave `run_refs=[]`.

- scripts/validate_process.sh: harness_error case | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Harness-error comments do not include the current Actions run URL.
  WHY: The diagnostic information remains incomplete for automated or human triage.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11564-11570 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The harness-error diagnostic comment can fail or be silently skipped before `ai:harness-broken` is applied.
  WHY: A failed API post or oversized diagnostic body can leave the issue labelled without diagnostic context; the severity differs between reviewers, so the highest reported severity is used.
